name: Mỗi năm một ga
notes: chapters = seconds in film.mp4 where the film waits for a tap, taken from scene.html by stops.py: the title frame, the train standing at each year's station (PAUSE.inBeat into the year), standing at Ga Hôm Nay (PAUSE.extra), the climax (PAUSE.climax: the ticket lifted off the table), and the last frame. Each sits a quarter of a frame into its frame, so a seek shows that frame and round(t * fps) finds its boxes. hints = the scene's own words at those stops (WORDS.cue, the next button's "Xem tiếp", WORDS.hint, ui.skip); a card can override them with "chapters". reveal = null: no 3D envelope; after the last stop a tap opens the letter. slots.json: sign0 ... sign4 are the year stations' names on their hanging signs (sign), cap0-k ... cap4-k the same names over the captions (label), cap0-l ... cap5-l the captions, the last one the arrival line (caption); they fade with the scene (alpha is the 5th number of each box). board is the years on the lit board at Ga Hôm Nay (sign), ticket-names and ticket-years the names and the years printed on the ticket (text, label). Compromises: the signs and the board show their words only while the train is (nearly) standing, since a plate rushing past at hundreds of pixels a frame cannot carry painted words, and the film blurs fast frames; every year sign is as wide as the Ga Hôm Nay sign. The ticket's names and years are painted once it is lifted and straight (on the table it lies small and tilted, and the player paints only upright boxes). The board's years are dimmed as much as the veil darkens the board. The posters on the platforms are the scene's stand-in drawings (rain, pines, cups, dinner, home): customer photos and a per-card choice of drawing cannot be in a film shared by every card. Ga Hôm Nay, its board line (năm bên nhau) and the ticket's print are the template's own words. fonts = the faces the player paints these slots in (latin, latin-ext and vietnamese).
